capabilities: Upload pasted or dragged images and files to Tencent Cloud COS and insert Markdown links
Batch upload local attachments from a note or the whole vault
Batch download COS attachments back to local storage
Move uploaded local attachments to system trash to free storage
Generate pre-signed temporary URLs for private buckets
extras: Bilingual (English/Chinese) README; not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; MIT licensed; settings require Bucket and Region values alongside credentials.
problem: Obsidian stores attachments locally, which fills up device storage—especially on mobile—and doesn't provide cloud image hosting.

requires.name: Tencent Cloud account with Secret ID and Secret Key

summary: Uploader that sends pasted or dragged images and attachments to Tencent Cloud COS and replaces local links with remote URLs.
